issues.detail: The Greek text 'ει εισελευσονται' (if they enter) does not contain a negation. The Vietnamese translation adds 'chẳng' (will not), which reverses the meaning of the conditional statement.

The Greek 'ει' is a conditional particle ('if'), but the Vietnamese translates it as 'có lời rằng' (there is a word that), which changes the grammatical structure from a condition to a reported statement.
